design.rule: replace calibrated-primary greedy sequence with specialist greedy sequence only for a different candidate allowed by candidate_mode whose weighted full-CTC log-probability advantage clears a frozen margin
design.selection_data: none; fixed before scoring train or validation labels

limitations: The base 90/10 logit blend and blank bias came from prior development exploration.
These are development validations, not an independent signer/capture set.
Recognition accuracy does not establish visually natural coarticulation.
